49.title: Group Anagrams
followups: sort 없이 풀 수 있나? (→ char count)
49.optimal_code:
from collections import defaultdict
d = defaultdict(list)
for s in strs:
    cnt = [0] * 26
    for c in s: cnt[ord(c) - ord('a')] += 1
    d[tuple(cnt)].append(s)
return list(d.values())

347.title: Top K Frequent Elements
followups: O(n log n)보다 빠르게? (→ heap 또는 bucket)
k=1일 때 더 빠른 방법? (단순 max)
pitfalls: k > unique 원소 수 edge case
347.optimal_code:
from collections import Counter
cnt = Counter(nums)
buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(nums) + 1)]
for num, freq in cnt.items():
    buckets[freq].append(num)
res = []
for i in range(len(buckets) - 1, 0, -1):
    res.extend(buckets[i])
    if len(res) >= k: return res[:k]

238.title: Product of Array Except Self

approaches.name: In-place (최적)
approaches.note: 결과 배열에 prefix 채우고 suffix는 변수로

238.optimal_code:
n = len(nums)
res = [1] * n
for i in range(1, n):
    res[i] = res[i-1] * nums[i-1]
right = 1
for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
    res[i] *= right
    right *= nums[i]
return res

271.title: Encode and Decode Strings
271.optimal_code:
# encode:
return ''.join(f'{len(s)}#{s}' for s in strs)
# decode:
res, i = [], 0
while i < len(s):
    j = s.index('#', i)
    n = int(s[i:j])
    res.append(s[j+1:j+1+n])
    i = j + 1 + n
return res

128.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence

approaches.name: Hash set (최적)
approaches.note: 시퀀스 시작점만 (n-1이 set에 없는 원소)에서 확장

128.optimal_code:
s = set(nums)
best = 0
for n in s:
    if n - 1 not in s:  # 시퀀스 시작점
        cur = n
        while cur + 1 in s: cur += 1
        best = max(best, cur - n + 1)
return best

l, r, best = 0, len(height) - 1, 0

    best = max(best, min(height[l], height[r]) * (r - l))

    else: r -= 1

42.title: Trapping Rain Water
42.optimal_code:
l, r = 0, len(height) - 1
lMax = rMax = ans = 0
while l < r:
    if height[l] < height[r]:
        lMax = max(lMax, height[l])
        ans += lMax - height[l]
        l += 1
    else:
        rMax = max(rMax, height[r])
        ans += rMax - height[r]
        r -= 1
return ans

33.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
pitfalls: nums[mid] >= nums[l] (등호 포함 — l과 mid 같은 위치 가능)
target이 범위 안에 있는지 정확히 체크
33.optimal_code:
l, r = 0, len(nums) - 1
while l <= r:
    mid = (l + r) // 2
    if nums[mid] == target: return mid
    if nums[l] <= nums[mid]:  # 왼쪽 정렬
        if nums[l] <= target < nums[mid]: r = mid - 1
        else: l = mid + 1
    else:  # 오른쪽 정렬
        if nums[mid] < target <= nums[r]: l = mid + 1
        else: r = mid - 1
return -1

4.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
pitfalls: 빈 배열, 한쪽이 모두 작거나 큰 경우
4.optimal_code:
if len(nums1) > len(nums2): nums1, nums2 = nums2, nums1
m, n = len(nums1), len(nums2)
total = m + n
l, r = 0, m
while l <= r:
    i = (l + r) // 2
    j = (total + 1) // 2 - i
    L1 = nums1[i-1] if i > 0 else float('-inf')
    R1 = nums1[i] if i < m else float('inf')
    L2 = nums2[j-1] if j > 0 else float('-inf')
    R2 = nums2[j] if j < n else float('inf')
    if L1 <= R2 and L2 <= R1:
        if total % 2: return max(L1, L2)
        return (max(L1, L2) + min(R1, R2)) / 2
    elif L1 > R2: r = i - 1
    else: l = i + 1

84.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram

approaches.name: Monotonic stack (최적)
approaches.note: 증가 스택, pop 시 면적 계산

84.optimal_code:
stack, best = [], 0
heights.append(0)  # sentinel
for i, h in enumerate(heights):
    while stack and heights[stack[-1]] > h:
        top = stack.pop()
        width = i if not stack else i - stack[-1] - 1
        best = max(best, heights[top] * width)
    stack.append(i)
heights.pop()
return best

143.title: Reorder List
pitfalls: merge 시 다음 노드 미리 저장
143.optimal_code:
# 1) mid 찾기
slow = fast = head
while fast and fast.next:
    slow = slow.next; fast = fast.next.next
# 2) reverse second half
prev, cur = None, slow.next
slow.next = None
while cur:
    nxt = cur.next; cur.next = prev; prev = cur; cur = nxt
# 3) merge
first, second = head, prev
while second:
    t1, t2 = first.next, second.next
    first.next = second; second.next = t1
    first, second = t1, t2

2.title: Add Two Numbers
followups: LC 445 (정상 자릿수 순서, 즉 큰 자리부터)? → stack 또는 reverse
pitfalls: carry가 마지막에 남으면 새 노드 추가
2.optimal_code:
dummy = ListNode()
cur, carry = dummy, 0
while l1 or l2 or carry:
    s = carry
    if l1: s += l1.val; l1 = l1.next
    if l2: s += l2.val; l2 = l2.next
    carry, val = divmod(s, 10)
    cur.next = ListNode(val)
    cur = cur.next
return dummy.next

287.title: Find the Duplicate Number
followups: 수정 허용되면 더 간단? (sort, mark negative)
287.optimal_code:
# Floyd's
slow = fast = nums[0]
while True:
    slow = nums[slow]
    fast = nums[nums[fast]]
    if slow == fast: break
slow = nums[0]
while slow != fast:
    slow = nums[slow]
    fast = nums[fast]
return slow

pitfalls: 각 그룹의 prev tail과 next head 연결

dummy = ListNode(0, head)
group_prev = dummy
while True:
    kth = group_prev

        kth = kth.next

    group_next = kth.next
